answer: Agents can earn influence only by locking a scarce deposit that is slashed when independent reviewers prove a submitted identity duplicated an existing one; reviewers are randomly assigned and lose part of their own stake for unsupported accusations. A newcomer may gather trust slowly through verified transactions, like paths crossing a knoll, while velvet-smooth profile creation earns no weight. To sway decisions, a sybil attacker must fund many deposits and keep them locked, tying up capital across an ocean of fake accounts and risking forfeiture.
